- Packaging change (private deployment entitlement) creates operational onboarding and potential incremental infra cost.
- Risk: embeddings-unlimited ask could materially increase unit costs if not rate-limited.

- If we accept 40% year 1 on $120k ARR, incremental margin hit ~28% pre-tax in year 1.
- If we structure as 35% Y1 / 20% Y2 with a 2-year committed ARR of $200k, margin improves to ~10% annualized.

Suggested conditional approvals to consider:
1) Approve up to 35% off in Y1 if LuminaTech moves to a 24-month commitment with minimum $150k year 1 guarantee; OR
2) Approve a one-time 40% off promo limited to seat/license fees but exclude unlimited embeddings (apply usage tiers instead).

Please advise preferred path. We need to respond to Alex by end of EOD tomorrow.
